question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Spick and span
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Very neat and clean'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'Spick and span' **means** 'Very neat and clean'.**
 
• **Spick and span:** neat, clean, and well looked after. (साफ, स्वच्छ और अच्छी तरह से देखभाल की जाने वाली)
 
 
• *Example: My little house is** spick and span. ***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Very neat and clean.*
